title: Ubizo Olungathotyelwanga Kwilizwe Lokuzikhukhumeza
intro: Umi kumanxuwa empucuko eyayikade inkulu, apho amandla nekratshi zazingenamida. Umthunywa wayehamba phakathi kwabo, ebiza inyaniso, kodwa iintliziyo zabo zazilukhuni. Isilumkiso asizange sithotyelwe, kwaye isibhakabhaka ngokwaso saba sisixhobo somsindo. Ngubani lo mthunywa, kwaye kwenzeka ntoni kwabo bangazange baluvume ubizo?
clues: Ndathunyelwa kubantu abanamandla angenakuthelekiswa nanto nabakha isikhumbuzo kuzo zonke iindawo eziphakamileyo.
Abantu bam babezicingela ukuba abanamandla, bathi, Ngubani na onamandla kunathi?
Ndibabizele ukuba banqule uAllah kuphela, kodwa bandityhola ngokuba ndingumntu ongento yanto nongaxokiyo.
Bandicel’ umngeni wokuba ndizise isohlwayo endandisithembisile ukuba ndithetha inyani.
U-Allah wabathumelela umoya ongenamandla ongashiyanga nto.
Mna nabo bakholwayo kunye nam sasindiswa yinceba ka-Allah, ngoxa abo bangakholwayo batshatyalaliswa ngokupheleleyo.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: UHud kunye namakholwa basindiswa, baza abangakholwayo batshatyalaliswa
UHud washiya abantu bakhe ngaphambi kokuba afumane isohlwayo
outcome.answer: UHud kunye namakholwa basindiswa, baza abangakholwayo batshatyalaliswa

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
